Identified as this saint because: A Menologion of Basil II miniature whose Commons description reads 'St Xanthippe Disciple of the Apostles, who died in Spain; St Polyxene the Disciple of the Apostles, who died in Spain' — the Xanthippe kept on 23 September, whom saint.gr pairs with Polyxene. Commons describes it: St Xanthippe Disciple of the Apostles, who died in Spain  St Polyxene the Disciple of the Apostles, who died in Spain
